response.sql: WITH vote_shares AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.death_country), ''), '') AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS share FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max > 0), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(share) AS average_share FROM vote_shares GROUP BY country) SELECT country, average_share, average_share / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_share) FROM country_averages), 0) AS relative_ratio FROM country_averages ORDER BY country

assumptions.assumption: Each computable award-vote row has equal weight; NULL, empty, and whitespace-only death countries form the blank group.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each player equal weight by averaging their computable vote shares first, then averaging players within each country.
